verdict.rationale: Veriff's API supports the core agentic loop — create a session (veriff-docs-6/31), poll the decision endpoint (veriff-docs-7), receive extracted/decision data via webhooks (veriff-docs-18, veriff-docs-41), and authenticate via HMAC/shared-secret (veriff-docs-5, veriff-docs-10, veriff-docs-42). Re-check/trigger-decision capability is only documented for test integrations (veriff-docs-9), not clearly for production re-checks, and there is no MCP server/surface anywhere in the docs, nor any concept of scoped/limited credentials tailored for agent access (only account-level HMAC secrets and admin portal logins per veriff-docs-47). missing for 10: MCP surface or agent-specific integration, scoped/limited-privilege credential mechanism, documented production-grade re-check/trigger endpoint.
